name: Healthcare and life sciences
description: Industry and marketing vocabulary only. Contains no clinical guidance and must not be used for medical content without review.

hasDefinedTerm.name: HIPAA
hasDefinedTerm.description: The US law governing the privacy and security of protected health information.

ctx.expansion: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act

hasDefinedTerm.name: PHI
hasDefinedTerm.description: Individually identifiable health data covered by HIPAA.

hasDefinedTerm.name: EHR
hasDefinedTerm.description: The digital record of a patient's care held by a provider organization.

hasDefinedTerm.name: payer
hasDefinedTerm.description: The organization that pays for care, typically an insurer or government program.

hasDefinedTerm.name: provider
hasDefinedTerm.description: The organization or clinician delivering care.

hasDefinedTerm.name: prior authorization
hasDefinedTerm.description: Approval a payer requires before it will cover a service or medication.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CPT code
hasDefinedTerm.description: A standardized code identifying a medical procedure for billing purposes.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ICD-10
hasDefinedTerm.description: The international classification system used to code diagnoses.

hasDefinedTerm.name: telehealth
hasDefinedTerm.description: Delivering care remotely by video, phone, or asynchronous messaging.

hasDefinedTerm.name: interoperability
hasDefinedTerm.description: The ability of health systems to exchange data and use what they receive.

hasDefinedTerm.name: FHIR
hasDefinedTerm.description: A standard for exchanging healthcare data over web APIs.

hasDefinedTerm.name: value-based care
hasDefinedTerm.description: Reimbursement tied to patient outcomes rather than volume of services delivered.

hasDefinedTerm.name: patient acquisition
hasDefinedTerm.description: The marketing function bringing new patients to a practice or health system.

hasDefinedTerm.name: YMYL
hasDefinedTerm.description: Your Money or Your Life. Google's designation for topics where inaccuracy could cause real harm, held to a higher quality bar.

hasDefinedTerm.name: medical review
hasDefinedTerm.description: Having a qualified clinician verify health content before publication. Expected practice for YMYL pages.

hasDefinedTerm.name: clinical trial
hasDefinedTerm.description: A structured study evaluating an intervention in human participants.

hasDefinedTerm.name: FDA clearance
hasDefinedTerm.description: A regulatory pathway permitting a device to be marketed in the US. Distinct from approval.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CMS
hasDefinedTerm.description: The US agency administering Medicare and Medicaid.

ctx.expansion: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services

hasDefinedTerm.name: population health
hasDefinedTerm.description: Managing outcomes across a defined group rather than one patient at a time.

hasDefinedTerm.name: care gap
hasDefinedTerm.description: A difference between recommended care and the care a patient has actually received.
